cohort: The study included all pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 who died during treatment at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology BMCRI and Bowring Lady Curzon Medical College.
finding: Among 1070 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19, 37 (3.45%) died due to the infection, with most deaths occurring in the third trimester.
gest_age: Maximum gestational age 37 weeks, and minimum gestational age 12 weeks
